annotations.title: Order printed posters on Zazzle: a ready order link and print image for each size

description: Order printed posters on Zazzle: a ready order link and print image for each size The poster from the dashboard's Print page, in the contest's language, with its QR code (it opens the public page only). orders maps each size (18x24 and 12x18 posters, 16x20 foam board) to a Zazzle link that opens that product filled in; give the person the link, and they order and pay on Zazzle. posters holds the print images. englishWords means the contest's language can't be printed yet, so the poster is in English. Sheets of entry signs aren't offered here: they carry entry codes, so they're ordered from the Print page. Needs the organizer key.

accent.description: The sign color as 6 hex digits, no # (e.g. 2446c8, the default blue). Use the contest theme's accent to match the dashboard's Print page.

slug.description: The id in the public link, e.g. `scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12` from https://qrvote.org/c/scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12
